measured.note: Measured single-threaded in pure Python on this machine, using public test scalars only. Optimised native or GPU implementations are typically 10^3 to 10^6 times faster; the report's rate table covers that range.

notes: Expected attempts are the mean of a geometric distribution; the actual first hit can be several times larger or smaller.
A mined prefix is not a weakness. It only shows the generator was run deliberately, which anybody can do.
No key is attacked here: the benchmark derives addresses from public test scalars, exactly as a wallet does.
verdict: cheap: the prefix fixes only 28 bits (1.9 days at this machine's measured rate), which is a few minutes of commodity GPU time. It therefore says nothing about the address's origin
